tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: No of Years of Experience Tenderer should have been in the business of providing manpower services for at least 3 (three) financial years. Preceding the last date for submission of Tenders. i.e 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26

Total number of Manpower deployed for any Central, StateGovt, Semi Govt Preceding 3 years from the last date for submission of Tenders should have successfully deployed manpower Driver, Loader, Cleaner and Driver Cum-Operator or Combined for any Central,StateGovt,Semi Govt such that the total/combined manpower deployed are not less than 128 persons users.
05. Registration with the Department of Labour
06. Registration under Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provident Act, 1952.
07. Registration under Employees State Insurance Act, 1948.

Total Annual Turnover in the Business of Manpower Services. The Tenderer should have minimum Average Annual Turnover of Rs.8,49,71,595/-Only from the last three completed financial Years preceding the last date for submission of Tenders (i.e.FinancialYear (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Total Credit Facility Tenderer should have credit facility of not less than Rs.1,06,21,450/- of credit line or letters of credit from the banks meeting the fund requirement
